name: The Acoustitute Songwriter Festival at Husets Biograf
description:
On the 7th of December Husets Biograf invites to a day of workshops and concerts, showcasing some of the most talented songwriters in the Copenhagen scene today. More info will follow soon.

Ticket prices:
Concerts only: 80 kr.
Workshops + concerts: 100 kr.
CASH/MOBILEPAY

Time schedule:
14:00 = Cinema café opens
15:00 - 18:00: Workshops 
18:30 = Cinema café opens
19:30 - 00:00: Concerts 
______________________________________________________

The workshops

Make your own music video with Johan:
"Hi, my name is Johan, I'm a Copenhagen based Visual Design & Videography based student, I work with everything from graphic design, motion graphics, to videography and editing. In this workshop we'll be covering some of the most helpful basics in what you need to know about making your own music videos, stuff like equipment, editing and what rules there are in videography. This is a workshop made to be accessible for everyone, so you don't need to worry about having any fancy equipment or well, any equipment at all, if you have a phone with a camera thats all you need! But if you do have a laptop and cameras etc. bring it if you feel like it! Looking forward to seeing you there!

Musical speed-meeting with Sofia Elisabeth Heilmann-Clausen:
Sofia Elisabeth Heilmann-Clausen (1994) is a poet, and lives in Nørrebro.
She debuted on the publisher Gladiator in December 2023 with the poetry collection "Det er himlen som
trækker vejret"- a collection of poems, that, with the changing of the seasons as a background, examines
an unfiltered mind's encounter with psychiatry and love. You can buy the book by following the link:
https://forlagetgladiator.dk/products/det-er-himlen-som-traekker-vejret (the book is also a good Christmas
present).
In collaboration with i.a. Læseforeningen, she has helped develop the concept "Skønlitterær Speed
Meeting". We are going to try this in a new and exciting form, where the music and songwriting are in
focus; we call it Musikalsk Speed Meeting.
In the Musikalsk Speed Meeting, in addition to meeting each other in alternating couples, we will
examine – through four carefully selected songs – how songwriting, musical tools and vocal performances
affect us, move us and inspire us.
Sofia steers the course of the battle, and makes sure that we all get through the conversations well.

____________________________________________________
Meet the songwriters!

Gudfare
I’ve always been drawn to writing – small poems, contrasts, rhythmic sentences. I’ve also almost always played the guitar, mostly for my own enjoyment as a favorite timestealer. In 2022, I had the idea to combine these passions – I know, mind-blowing! 
I called it Gudfare, as an alterego for hiding stagefright, but that’s another story. 

The Danish language has about a third of the words compared to English. While English might allow for more precision, Danish sometimes conveys more with less. It’s about what’s said between the lines, the implied, the felt but not spoken. An English proverb ironicly captures this
"Less is more."

When I write a song, it needs to resonate with me. I need to connect emotionaly to it, and i can be quite critical on what is finished. But suddenly, I found myself on stage, performing songs that moved me – and sometimes those who listened. Even though it’s my song, written words, the interpretation can vary, and isnt mine alone anymore. I find that very interesting.

I look forward to share a few short, some finished, and some new songs in the making with you

Sigrid Eva:
Sigrid Eva invites you on a musical journey where present storytelling about life creates a deeply personal concert experience with a sound that ranges between softness and grandeur.

Singer, songwriter and pianist, Sigrid Eva, released her debut EP, "Oceans Away", in 2023 and has since headlined concerts at RUST (Copenhagen), Musikhuset København and Fatter Eskil (Aarhus). She has recently wrapped up her first Denmark tour in the fall of 2024 and among other places visited RIGA in Hvidovre. She is set to  kick off 2025 with concerts at CPH Vinterjazz Festival among other places, and rounds out the spring with her first England tour.

Raised in a home of classical piano music, Sigrid's interest in music developed at a young age, and today she has found sanctuary in creating music. Sigrid Eva draws her audience into her own musical universe molded by a life where the program consists of piano études during the day and 'free play' in the evening. With impassioned and poetic lyrics, Sigrid exixts in a world of contemporary songwriting, where the music contains strong rhytms and impressionistic piano playing all at once.
Look forward to a musical experience with personality. A concert, where the audience can lean into stories about love, identity and self discovery, and where Sigrids lyrics function as a "safe space" for the most human emotions.

ROSANNA PANG: 
With honest lyrics, heavy taboo subjects and beautiful melodies, Rosanna Pang is a new breath in the pulsating pop world.  Her transparent lyrics, which are characterized by 
vulnerability and honesty, make her music unique. She grew up on "Vestegnen" in a family 
of Chinese immigrants, and sings, amongst other things, of a difficult upbringing characterized by suicidal thoughts, loneliness and the lack of support, love and care.

name: UDSOLGT Særvisning: No Other land med besøg af Nagieb Khaja
description:
Kom til særvisning af dokumentarfilmen NO OTHER LAND, som var den mest sete dokumentarfilm under CPH:DOX tilbage i marts. Filmen bliver introduceret af Nagieb Khaja, som selv er prisvindende dokumentarisk og krigsrapporter i Mellemøsten.

NO OTHER LAND giver et menneskeligt indblik i den højaktuelle konflikt mellem Israel og Palæstina gennem sit portræt af alliancen mellem en palæstinensisk aktivist og en israelsk journalist. En fortælling om såvel den territoriale konflikt og om de mennesker, der er fanget midt i den. Filmen har allerede trukket internationale overskrifter og er en af årets mest omdiskuterede dokumentarfilm.
